import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json

def run(_context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    targets = {'mx_plate_gasket v1', 'mx_plate_right_tb_gasket v1'}
    docs = [app.documents.item(i) for i in range(app.documents.count) if app.documents.item(i).name in targets]
    out = []
    for doc in docs:
        name = doc.name
        closed = bool(doc.close(False))
        out.append({'document': name, 'closed_without_saving': closed})
    print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False))
